english.note: Use this specifically when someone has become too big for clothes, shoes, or another wearable item.

examples.english: As a child, I would quickly outgrow my shoes and always had to buy a new pair.
examples.traditional: 我細路仔嗰陣啲鞋好快就著唔落，成日要買過對。
